items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I never did see the place, but I used to get letters from Bill, especially.

ctx.x: It was a basement apartment, that's all I remember.
I never did see the place, but I used to get letters from Bill, especially. Yeah. Bunk hardly ever wrote in those days. When he was on the road, he hardly ever wrote a letter.
